bio: Studies calibration and non-common-path aberration characterisation for NIRVANA-VIS, with wider adaptive-optics testing interests.
long_bio: Remon undertakes doctoral research linked to advanced adaptive-optics instrumentation at INAF Padova. A public AO4ELT conference programme identifies his work on non-common-path aberration characterisation for NIRVANA-VIS. That topic connects calibration, optical modelling and test procedures to reliable performance of a complex telescope instrument.
